title: Ranks and Kits
needs_owner_check: The kits table (smp-kits) is generated from PlayerKits2 (Diamond Kit every 12 h), while /help and Essentials kits.yml list a different set (starter, claim, daily, tools, diamond once a day, rank kits). Which plugin answers /kit on live, and should the table cover both? Store rank perks are copied from src/data/storeContent.json; the auction listing counts there (15/25/50) do not match ChromaticAuctionHouse config.yml (75 default), so they are left out.
summary: **Ranks and Kits**: Explorer ranks are earned in game with `/rankup`, store ranks add perks and a daily rank kit, and kits are free gear on a timer.

blocks.p: Explorer ranks run from Tin to Prismatic. The store ranks are VIP, VIP+, MVP and MVP+.

`/ranks` shows every Explorer rank and what it needs. When you have done everything a rank asks for, run `/rankup`. Each rank up hands out rewards such as spawners and money, and raises how fast you earn [claim blocks](/wiki/smp/claims/).
Store ranks are bought on [the store](/store/). Each one includes everything in the rank below it.

ul: Prismatic (the final rank, which also gives an auto-sell chest)

blocks.p: **VIP**: [VIP] chat tag, 10 homes, 5 auto-sell chests, 2 player warps, `/back` (also after death), `/hat`, `/near`, `/nick`, 1.25x mcMMO XP, 2 spawner storage pages, 150 upgradeable hoppers, and `/kit vip` once every 24 hours (a Shard Key and 200 Prism Shards) plus `/kit diamond`.

**VIP+**: [VIP+] tag, 15 homes, 10 auto-sell chests, 3 player warps, `/enderchest`, `/itemname` with colour codes, 1.5x mcMMO XP, 3 spawner storage pages, 175 upgradeable hoppers, and `/kit vipplus` (a Spawner Key and 500 Prism Shards).

**MVP**: [MVP] tag, 20 homes, 15 auto-sell chests, 8 player warps, `/condense`, `/feed`, `/repair` and `/repair all`, `/workbench`, mcMMO abilities that last 12 seconds longer with halved cooldowns, the mcMMO Lucky perk, 5 spawner storage pages, 200 upgradeable hoppers, and `/kit mvp` (a Chroma Key and 750 Prism Shards).
**MVP+**: [MVP+] tag, 25 homes, 250 upgradeable hoppers, and `/kit mvpplus` (a Chroma Key, a Shard Key and 1,000 Prism Shards).
`/kit` lists your kits. A kit on cooldown tells you when it is ready again, and a locked one tells you which rank unlocks it.

ul: **Starter Kit**: basic armour, tools and food. Once only.
**Claim Kit**: a golden shovel and claim blocks so you can protect your base.
**Tools Kit**: a fresh set of tools every 10 minutes.
**VIP, VIP+, MVP and MVP+ Kits**: once every 24 hours with the matching rank.
Check `/ranks` early. The first rank up comes quickly, and its spawner is the start of a farm.
Rank kits pay Prism Shards every day, which adds up for [crafting](/wiki/smp/crafting/).
